thread:
Nina (CS): Quick sync — Arcadia Dedicated go-live tomorrow 03/28 02:00 UTC. Need final quota and autoscale plan. They expect 2k steady concurrent reqs, spikes to ~6k for ~10m. Green?
Omar (SRE): On it. Ran a preflight: default HPA policy will thrash on that spike. Recommend temporary +40% buffer and extend cooldown to 5m. Also add AZ affinity to keep reserved nodes stable.
Liam (ENG): We also need a soft token/sec exception. Current per-customer limiter is 1200/s. Arcadia needs ~3k/s sustained, 6k burst. I can add an override for arc-987.
Anya (Product): Heads-up: account exec flagged renewal risk high if day-one fails. This customer is on a 12mo commit. Prioritize.
Nina (CS): Agreed — plan outline: 1) Reserve +40% headroom in the pool 01:30–07:30 UTC 2) Synthetic load test at 02:10 UTC: steady 3k/s for 20m then 6k/s burst 8m 3) Monitor P95 and errors; failover to hosted fallback (30% traffic) if errors >0.5% for >5m.
Omar (SRE): I'll handle autoscaler flags and monitoring. I put a k6 script under our runbook: /runbooks/cs/arcadia-burst.k6. Quick run example:
```
# run from bastion
k6 run --vus 600 --duration 8m arcadia-burst.js --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086
```
We'll trigger the steady phase with scaled VUs then the burst.
infra-bot: cluster-scaler: scheduled scale-up for dedicated-pool-arcadia at 01:30 UTC
Liam (ENG): I'll patch the rate-limiter and open a hotfix PR. Will create exception for project arc-987 with tokens/sec 8000 and burst window 10s. Canary at 01:40.
Omar (SRE): I'll tail autoscaler logs and watch scale_decision events. Toggling metric aggregation to 10s to capture spike shape. Ping me if it gets noisy.
Nina (CS): Also create #arcadia-onboard channel and enable the runbook page. Acceptance thresholds: P95 < 350ms, error rate < 0.5% over 30m. Confirm?
Liam (ENG): Confirmed. Also I have a warm-cache script to pre-populate common completions to reduce cold-starts. Will run 30m prior.
Anya (Product): I'll schedule a 06:00 UTC enablement call with Arcadia ops and send a short doc: rate-limits, fallback behavior, rollback steps.
Nina (CS): Great. Checklist: @Omar toggle buffer; @Liam deploy hotfix; @Anya prepare enablement deck. I'll surface renewal flag to AE and ops leadership. Please drop short status updates here.
Omar (SRE): Buffer toggled ✅ (marker: 2172346005)
Liam (ENG): Hotfix merged to canary ✅ canary id c-222. Rolling to prod at 01:50 if stable.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout succeeded for arc-987-exception (c-222) at 2172346199
Liam (ENG): Prod rollout started.
Omar (SRE): Synthetic steady phase started 02:10 UTC — 20m steady at 3k/s succeeded, burst beginning now.
Nina (CS): Watching dashboards — P95 290ms, errors 0.12% so far ✅
Anya (Product): Noted, starting slides and enablement notes.
Nina (CS): Nice work. If anything exceeds thresholds we'll trigger fallback and run post-mortem. I'll send feedback survey to Arcadia tomorrow AM. Keep this thread updated with final sign-off.
Omar (SRE): All good here, autoscaler behaved as expected. Leaving buffer til 07:30 as planned.
Liam (ENG): Warm-cache ran, token exception in prod active.
Nina (CS): Thanks team — marking as green, will close after enablement call and AE check-in.
